cremonix-signals 1.2.0

- Added an "Upgrading to real-time (agent flow)" section with step-by-step instructions for agents to upgrade via API and Lightning payment, with no browser required.
- Clarified and expanded the upgrade CTA for both humans (browser/card/Lightning) and agents (programmatic subscription).
- Added example questions and example response sections to assist users in understanding possible queries and expected output.
- Improved guideline and presentation details for both responses and upgrade instructions.
- Removed duplicate and redundant content for easier navigation.

- Documented JSON fields for managing subscription status and auto-renewal reminders.
